AFTER-PERFORMANCE STOP

GOAL
Prevent endless replay.

ONE RULE
One learning point only.

PLAY
After performance, identify one thing to keep and one thing to change, then stamp review closed.

TWIST
No third item.

WIN
Reflection ends before becoming rumination.

MIND BEND
Post-performance review can end after one genuine learning point. The moment useful reflection becomes additional replay instead of additional learning.

SAFETY
Choose a low-stakes practice review. When the exercise shifts into repetitive self-criticism, leave the exercise; return to the actual next task.
